description: Unblocker for AI agents: send {url} and get the page back as clean Markdown, with title, description, language, final URL and HTTP status. Gets through Cloudflare and other common bot protection and can render JavaScript-heavy pages. Set format to html or text for those instead. A page that can't be fetched (blocked, error status or empty) is not charged. No API key, proxy or account: pay per call in USDC over x402 (Base, Polygon) or MPP (Base).

format.description: how the page comes back in content

url.description: absolute http or https URL of a public page, e.g. "https://example.com/"

name: unblock
title: Unblocker: any URL to clean Markdown
